candidates.name: SDL3
candidates.purpose: Provide window, input, and platform-event services for a future interactive host through a narrow platform adapter.
decision_gates: An interactive workload requires windows or player input and defines the supported desktop targets.
The adapter demonstrates event, focus, input-device, and shutdown behavior without exposing vendor types in core contracts.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.

candidates.name: Jolt
candidates.purpose: Evaluate collision and rigid-body simulation behind an engine-owned physics adapter.
decision_gates: A concrete collision or movement scenario defines units, collision layers, fixed-step behavior, and acceptance limits.
A bounded fixture demonstrates cooking, object ownership, region retirement, and stale-result rejection; determinism claims are limited to measured evidence.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.

candidates.name: Recast/Detour
candidates.purpose: Evaluate navigation-mesh cooking and bounded path queries while retaining world routing and behavior policy in the engine.
decision_gates: A navigation workload defines traversability, query limits, tile ownership, and behavior when a route or tile is unavailable.
A fixture demonstrates repeatable cooking, query budgets, streamed-tile retirement, and rejection of results for obsolete world state.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.

candidates.name: ozz-animation
candidates.purpose: Evaluate skeletal animation preparation and runtime sampling without delegating gameplay animation policy or asset ownership.
decision_gates: An animation workload supplies original or cleared skeleton and clip assets with explicit coordinate and time conventions.
A fixture measures sampling and memory cost, checks skeleton/clip compatibility, and demonstrates safe content replacement and retirement.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.

candidates.name: meshoptimizer
candidates.purpose: Evaluate offline mesh optimization and level-of-detail preparation for a future geometry cooking pipeline.
decision_gates: A geometry workload defines source provenance, supported attributes, output format, and acceptable geometric or visual error.
A repeatable cook demonstrates quality and size benefits, validates malformed input bounds, and identifies whether any runtime decoding code is required.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.

candidates.name: Dear ImGui
candidates.purpose: Evaluate a developer diagnostics or authoring interface once an interactive host and graphics backend exist.
decision_gates: A specific developer workflow defines the data model, event routing, and ownership of edits.
An adapter demonstrates frame/resource lifetime and input isolation, and the headless build remains usable without the GUI integration.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.

candidates.name: Tracy
candidates.purpose: Evaluate optional development profiling for a named runtime performance investigation.
decision_gates: A repeatable workload defines the profiling question, annotations, host configuration, and capture procedure.
The experiment measures instrumentation overhead and memory use, documents capture transport, and verifies disabled and enabled builds separately.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.

candidates.name: RenderDoc
candidates.purpose: Evaluate an external graphics capture and inspection workflow for the selected future native renderer.
decision_gates: A renderer exists and a specific graphics defect or acceptance route requires capture on a defined host and API.
A capture/replay experiment records compatibility and limitations, and distinguishes external tool use from any in-process API integration or redistribution.
The selected use passes the common revision, provenance, license, and distribution review in docs/production/dependency-policy.md and is not required by the headless build.

candidates.name: GameNetworkingSockets
candidates.purpose: Evaluate optional transport only if the owner separately chooses a networked product; authority, replication, and services remain engine responsibilities.
decision_gates: A product decision and ADR explicitly accept networked scope and define authority, identity, trust boundaries, and supported connection modes.
A bounded multi-client fixture measures loss, latency, disconnect, reconnect, and invalid-message behavior, with optional dependencies and service requirements identified.
The proposed integration passes the common revision, provenance, license, offline-build, and packaging gates in docs/production/dependency-policy.md.
